prompt:
Scene:
A square-format ground-level 90s flash photograph of a coiled pool lane rope resting on wet deck tile at night, inside an indoor pool facility. The camera is held low, about 40 centimeters off the ground. Direct on-camera flash hits the rope as the primary light. Distant overhead fluorescents glow faintly in the background. 35mm grain, mild green cast.

Subject:
A polyethylene pool lane rope coiled into two overlapping loops on the cream-white deck tile. The rope consists of alternating blue and white floating discs around a central cable. Beside the coil sits a puddle the size of a dinner plate reflecting the flash as a bright hotspot. Beyond the coil, the edge of the pool basin drops away into shadow, and a portion of the aqua tile wall is visible across the void.

Important details:
Lane rope floats must show as molded plastic, not photorealistic gemstone. Deck tile grout must be visible. Puddle should read as chlorinated — slightly bluish. The absence of a swimmer is emphasized by how neatly the rope is coiled, as if put away at closing time. No person, no flip-flops, no gym bag.

Use case:
Empty Pool single study 3/5, low-angle isolated study of lane rope on deck.

Constraints:
No readable text, no watermark, no logos, preserve exact 1:1 aspect ratio, no person, no reflection of photographer in puddle, no cinematic grade, no dramatic shadow shapes.
